reason: The launch entrance for OpeningScreen: one app-ui module holds the flock's pure geometry and timing so it can be tested without a browser, and screens.tsx draws it on a canvas and exports useLaunchEntrancePlaying so an app can hold a fast open until the mark has landed. The five geometry exports exist for those tests and the screen; no new package, dependency or runtime API outside @mdbase-dev/ui/screens.
